intentionalNullColumns.reason: Three-state by design (SCOPE-111 FR-030): NULL means inherit testplans.forcetest, TRUE/FALSE override it in either direction. All-null means no administrator has needed an override yet, not that the writer is dead. Adding NOT NULL, adding a default, or dropping it as an unused column silently un-forces every inheriting test item -- a fail-OPEN release gate. See migration 0063 and [SCOPE 111 / T045].
